verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a REST API with a machine-readable OpenAPI spec and per-endpoint reference covering agents, runs, browser sessions and credentials, plus Python/TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server with 117 tools. That makes the core UI functions (running tasks and agents, managing sessions and credentials) programmatically accessible. However, no evidence explicitly claims API–UI parity, and several UI-only features have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of the visual drag-and-drop builder, browser recorder, SOP upload, Copilot chat, scheduling/template sharing and org/team settings, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Drive a cloud browser from Python or TypeScript with AI actions and Playwright, or run tasks and agents through the REST API.
